import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('plugin installation finishes', async function () {
  const { createResult, exitStatusFor } = await import(process.env.BDD_CORPUS_RESULT_RUNTIME!);
  const failed = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1';
  this.result = createResult({
    state: failed ? 'failed' : 'healthy',
    effects: {
      configuration: [{ kind: 'plugin', target: 'safeword', operation: 'installed' }],
    },
    errors: failed ? [{ code: 'INSTALL_FAILED', message: 'failed', retryable: false }] : [],
    recovery: [
      { command: '/reload-plugins', description: 'Reload installed plugins', requiresHuman: true },
    ],
  });
  this.exitCode = exitStatusFor(this.result);
});
Then('installation succeeds and reload guidance is shown', function () {
  assert.equal(this.exitCode, 0);
  assert.equal(this.result.ok, true);
  assert.equal(this.result.state, 'healthy');
  assert.deepEqual(this.result.errors, []);
  assert.deepEqual(this.result.effects.configuration, [
    { kind: 'plugin', target: 'safeword', operation: 'installed' },
  ]);
  assert.equal(this.result.recovery[0].command, '/reload-plugins');
});
